methodology: Historical totals include measured/reconstructed request counters only; no character estimates.
Accounting-gap warnings cover selected source history and can extend outside the report period.
Context categories estimate visible text; hidden schemas, prompts and multimodal content are unknown.
Local rolling usage is distinct from provider-defined quotas and can omit other devices/cloud work.
API-equivalent cost uses per-request reference rates, excludes unrecorded tool fees and is not a subscription bill.
Harness labels can hide proxy routes. Reported/unverified models are reference comparisons; use an explicit attribution map for GLM or other routed sessions. Known provider mismatches are unpriced.

session_inspection.nested_tool_count_basis: Static call sites in recorded functions.exec code; these are not separately billed model requests
session_inspection.resource_inventory_limit: Literal file-read commands and Python script invocations detected statically; imported modules, variable-based reads and scans are described separately, not claimed as an exhaustive OS audit
session_inspection.exactness: Historical native request counters are exact recorded counts. Category token estimates and tool/skill content proxies are not exact per-element or causal token costs. Hidden overhead cannot be enumerated exactly.
session_inspection.scope_warning: Previously returned cross-session statistics are text within this conversation, not usage rows to add to its own request totals.
session_inspection.snapshot_limit: The current collection tool can appear without its result. Later tool results, this report and the final assistant reply are outside the frozen request cutoff. A live session has no knowable final total before it ends.
session_inspection.content_policy: No raw prompts, responses, commands, tool results, reasoning text or credentials are exported; only counts, safe resource names/paths and task descriptions.
session_inspection.browser_check: Visual browser verification unavailable after the earlier Computer Use URL-confidence stop. Offline structure and embedded JSON are checked locally.
